text: これこそ　しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごとじゃー！

structure.jp: しんの　ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる
structure.en: what will remain in true Pokémon history

structure.jp: いだいな　しごとじゃー！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンの　れきしに　のこる　いだいな　しごと
patterns.explanation: A plain verb placed before a noun describes that noun. れきしにのこるしごと = 'work that remains in history'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃー is an old-man form of だ. しごとじゃー = 'it is a work!'
